claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves EH IMR 18650 2000mAh 8C as a 2000mAh preset with a 8C runtime rating.
EH IMR 18650 2000mAh is documented as a button-top offering, while historical aggregate records also show a flat-top variant; this catalog entry lacks a revision marker.

The EH IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for EH IMR 18650 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
